newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-WALSH KEEPS CAPTAINCY AGAINST SRI LANKA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WALSH KEEPS CAPTAINCY AGAINST SRI LANKA.

text.p: Courtney Walsh has been retained to captain West Indies against Sri Lanka on their short tour of the Caribbean starting next week.
Walsh, who became skipper after the World Cup last year when Richie Richardson retired from international cricket, is in charge for the two tests and one limited overs match against Sri Lanka.
West Indies' squad for the one-day international in Port of Spain, Trinidad, next Friday is to be named on Monday.
